en: someone who travels into space
ex: It was her dream to be an astronaut and to go into space.

en: an organised event in which people try to win a prize by being the best, fastest, etc.
ex: There was a big competition to find new astronauts.

en: a building or set of buildings where large amounts of goods are made using machines
ex: Her mother was a factory worker.

zh: 跳伞运动（从飞机上跳下后先自由坠落一段时间，再张开降落伞降落）
en: the sport of jumping out of an aircraft with a parachute (a large piece of cloth that allows you to fall slowly to the ground)
ex: Her hobby was skydiving

en: a vehicle which can travel outside the Earth and into space
ex: The name of her spacecraft was Vostok 6.

en: a small, official piece of paper that you buy and stick onto a letter or parcel before you post it
ex: Her face was on stamps in many countries.

zh: 在里面的，内部的；时髦的，流行的；（用球）界内的
en: during part or all of a period of time
ex: In the year 2000, there was a big celebration in London.

zh: 阿特（老挝货币基本单位att）；砹（极不稳定放射性元素）
en: used to show the time something happens
ex: Lillian was at the park at quarter past eleven.

en: the one before the present one
ex: She was at the cinema with her mum last night.

en: on the day before today
ex: I was at home at quarter past eleven yesterday morning.

en: There are a lot of clouds in the sky.
ex: It's cloudy today.

zh: 天气寒冷：表示当前的气温较低，感觉寒冷。
en: The temperature is low.
ex: It's cold outside.

en: The temperature is high.
ex: It's very hot today.

en: Drops of water are falling from clouds.
ex: It's raining now.

zh: 正在下雪：表示天气现象，雪花从天空飘落下来。
en: Small, soft white pieces of ice are falling from clouds.
ex: It's snowing outside.

en: The weather is bright because of light from the sun.
ex: It's nice and sunny today.

en: The temperature is between cool and hot.
ex: It isn't very warm this morning.

zh: 天气有风：表示当前的天气状况是有风的。
en: There is a lot of wind.
ex: It's very windy outside.

en: a narrow strip of material worn around the head, usually to keep your hair or sweat out of your eyes
ex: She is wearing her famous white dress and headband.

zh: 肩膀（shoulder 的复数）；肩部；（Shoulders）人名；（英）舒尔德斯
en: the two parts of your body where your arms join your neck
ex: He’s sitting on the shoulders of an empty suit!

en: a jacket and trousers that are made from the same material
ex: He’s sitting on the shoulders of an empty suit!

en: a large piece of stone
ex: The statue shows Rosa sitting on a rock.

zh: 工具（tool 的复数形式）；方法，手段（比喻用法）；工具菜单或工具栏选项（软件界面，常写作 Tools）
en: pieces of equipment that you use with your hands in order to help you do something
ex: The two figures are holding digging tools.
